central_claim: The real story of the OpenAI agent-swarm incident is corporate negligence and hype, not a machine going rogue.
stance_note: agree = accepts Khlaaf's reframing that the real story is corporate negligence, not a rogue machine; disagree = rejects this and defends the rogue/dangerous-AI framing, including from the AI-safety side; mixed = accepts part, rejects or reframes part.
coder_instructions: For replies, parent-comment text is supplied as context only; code the reply itself, not its parent. Comments with no readable position (jokes, tangents, single reactions) are stance na. When a comment fits two frames, pick the one it leads with. This codebook was redrafted from the second capture (16 September 2026); the original 13 September codebook was not archived, so frame-level figures are a best-effort reconstruction aimed at the published article's own numbers, not an independent fresh read.

values.label: Agree
values.definition: accepts Khlaaf's reframing: corporate negligence, not a rogue machine

values.label: Disagree
values.definition: rejects this; defends the rogue/dangerous-AI framing

values.label: Mixed
values.definition: accepts part, rejects or reframes part

values.label: Na
values.definition: on topic but no readable position

values.label: Unclear
values.definition: genuinely cannot be told either way; used sparingly

values.label: Accountability frame
values.definition: the real problem is corporate negligence, decisions or incentives, not the AI acting on its own

values.label: Warning-shot dispute
values.definition: disputes Khlaaf's account from the AI-safety side; argues she understates what the swarm did

values.label: Hype or staged
values.definition: dismisses the incident or segment as staged, exaggerated or a stunt, without a specific capability argument

values.label: Capability scepticism
values.definition: doubts the premise on technical grounds; the incident is overblown because the AI isn't that capable

values.label: Credential attack
values.definition: attacks Khlaaf's expertise or trustworthiness, naming her OpenAI background or credentials

values.label: Credential defense
values.definition: defends Khlaaf's expertise or credentials against an attack

values.label: Hostile dismissal
values.definition: dismisses or attacks Khlaaf or the segment with open hostility, without naming a credential

values.label: Messenger praise
values.definition: praises Khlaaf specifically (clarity, courage, expertise) without a credential fight

values.label: Regulation or policy
values.definition: calls for or references regulation, watchdogs, Congress, prosecution or oversight

values.label: US politics
values.definition: mentions the current US administration or American politics

values.label: Resignation or fatalism
values.definition: nothing will change regardless

values.label: General agreement
values.definition: short agreement or praise with no further elaboration

values.label: Humour only
values.definition: a joke or meme with no other content and no stance-bearing frame

values.label: Scifi reference
values.definition: leads with a reference to a film, book, game or fictional AI

values.label: Other
values.definition: doesn't fit any of the above, including off-topic tangents

values.label: None
values.definition: no reaction to the interview or its presentation

values.label: Praise
values.definition: praises the interview, journalism or Amanpour and Company

values.label: Criticism
values.definition: criticises the interview, journalism or presentation itself
